# Cluster-specific (one cluster's installation, recorded for reproducibility): the only shipped recipe naming the
# cd-xl-central environment is configs/encoders/mimic-mean.yaml, whose source checkpoint is not public.
# Constraints for central-dogma's xl-central environment (PGLM-1B, configs/encoders/pglm-1b.yaml), recorded from a
# working environment on 2026-10-06 (Python 3.11.11, torch 2.9.1 from PyPI, CUDA 12.8). The environment was made with
# --system-site-packages over a base Python 3.11.11 installation, so it has two parts. This file: the environment's own
# packages (they shadow the base installation's where both exist, e.g. torch 2.9.1 over its 2.6.0), installed with
# `pip install -r`. cd-xl-central-module.txt: the base installation's packages that are not shadowed, which it
# provides; a rebuild applies them with -c. Every version is the one that imports.
# Editable sources (not pip-installable from an index; installed --no-deps -e):
#   central-dogma @ git+ssh://git@github.com/PolymathicAI/central-dogma.git@9ae01d18b0017aa5372c2984dd8aa06bf997bac1
#   eva @ git+ssh://git@github.com/PolymathicAI/EVA.git@1f9b98143ad89177a5fce4de629ce6316dbeffc6  (central-dogma's
#     pretraining/ submodule, at the commit the superproject records)
